author: Cinna Davis (OpenAI Codex assisted)
statement: A deterministic local-ring compiler factors an integer matrix modulo 2^P with inner dimension at most its rational rank and P-bit factors. Applied to crossing pieces it replaces explicit small integer factors by rational rank bounds, with a polynomial precision cap paying all known normalizers and canonical creation identities. The written master-time transfer is conditional on the stated rank-only family and retains all outer costs; exponential-space compilation is explicit. No cheaper rank family or SAT exponent is obtained.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the all-size rank-factor and precision/master transfer arguments
A uniformly evaluable cheaper crossing family with both rational rank bounds and a paid normalizer
Polynomial-space compilation, if that guarantee is desired; current generic factors use exponential space
A rational odd-prime transfer needs its own bounded-query, bad-prime, probability and worst-outcome time proof
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; author-checked, no independent or formal review
